title: Locale — Free Bootstrap 6 Directory Website Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 directory and listings template — searchable filters, map rail, listing grid and a full business detail page.
yoastTitle: Locale — Free Bootstrap 6 Directory Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 directory template with searchable Combobox filters, chip tags, a collapsing category nav, map rail and a full listing detail page with reviews and opening hours.
intro: Locale is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 directory and listings template for city guides, local business directories and marketplaces. It pairs a filterable results page — search bar, category nav, map rail and listing grid — with a complete business detail page covering reviews, opening hours, photos and a review form.
note: This is the template that makes the strongest case for Bootstrap 6. The search bar uses searchable and multi-select Comboboxes, the category nav uses Nav overflow to fold extra items into a menu as the viewport narrows, and the filter drawer combines Chip input, Range with a value bubble and the new Datepicker. Not one of those components exists in Bootstrap 5.
summary: Locale is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 directory and listings template for city guides and local business directories. The results page combines a Combobox-driven search bar, a Nav overflow category strip, a sticky map rail with synced pins, and a filter drawer built from Chip input, Range and Datepicker. The detail page covers tabs, reviews, opening hours, a photo grid and a review form. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Two pages — filterable results page and a full listing detail page
Search bar built on Combobox, including a searchable multi-select for categories
Category nav using Nav overflow — extra items fold into a menu automatically
Filter drawer combining Chip input, Range with live value bubble and the new Datepicker
Sticky map rail with pins that highlight as you hover or focus a listing
Listing detail page with tabs, reviews, opening hours, photo grid and a review form
Native <dialog> drawers for filters and mobile navigation
Retheme the whole directory by changing a single --brand token
Full dark mode via data-bs-theme, remembered across visits
Native form validation with data-bs-validate and :user-invalid
ESM-only vanilla JavaScript — no jQuery, no bundler, no build step
